VM - Variable Attribute.vi

Owning Palette: Advanced VarMan VIs

Reads or writes a variable attribute. An attribute is arbitrary data is to be associated with the variable. An attribute is stored as a string; if other data type is desired for attribute, use any method to convert it to/from string.
Also see VarMan overview.

Click the parameters for more information

 

VC Handle specifies a handle of the variable context where a desired variable resides. In order to refer to a global variable, pass value of -1 to VC Handle or keep it unwired. VC Handle is ignored if name_spec refers to a variable by an alias.
name_spec defines the name specifier of the target variable. Usually, this is merely a variable name; however, additional options are available. See the Referring to variables topic for details.
Attribute in. Pass a value is to be written to the variable attribute.
cmd (read) specifies the operation to perform:

0readread attribute (by default).
1writewrite attribute.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
dup name_spec is a flow-through parameter with the same value as name_spec.
Attribute out returns a value of the variable attribute when reading operation is performed. If the variable has no attribute associated, it returns an empty string (no errorin this case).
DBL value returns a value of the given variable if it has DBL Scalar data type and reading operation has been performed.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains VarMan VI error code identifying an error if any occurred. If no error occurred, it is equal to zero.
source contains the error description and VI location information if an error occurred.
type code returns a data type of the specified variable.
writer ID returns the Writer ID for the current variable value.
